concerns.text: Task T036 ('Implement Streaming for Large Datasets') is tagged [US2] but addresses a data loading constraint (FR-001/US-1) and memory limit (Plan.md) that applies to the entire dataset ingestion, not just the heuristic comparison. The task description implies a fix for the data loader (`code/data_loader.py`), which is the prerequisite for US1, US2, and US3. Tagging it solely to US2 creates a coverage gap for US1 and US3 regarding the streaming requirement.

Task T037 ('Enhance Degenerate Graph Handling') is tagged [US4] but the logic required (detecting disconnected components in `graph_utils.py`) is a prerequisite for the traversal strategies in US1 (Full), US2 (Lazy/Greedy), and US3 (Analysis). If T037 is only implemented for US4, the baseline (US1) and heuristics (US2) may crash on degenerate inputs before T037 is executed, violating the independence of US1/US2.

Task T011b ('Verify noise injection logic') is tagged [US1] but the validation logic described (checking edge replacement ratio) is a unit test for `graph_utils.py` (FR-001). While US1 uses noisy graphs, the verification of the noise generation mechanism itself is a foundational requirement (FR-001) that should be decoupled or explicitly linked to the data generation phase to ensure FR-001 is covered independently of US1 execution.

Task T039 ('Add Deterministic Seed Verification') is tagged [US1] but the requirement for reproducibility (Constitution Principle I) applies to the entire pipeline (US1, US2, US3). Tagging it only to US1 suggests that seed verification for US2 and US3 is optional or deferred, which contradicts the Constitution. The task should be re-tagged as [P] (Parallel/Shared) or linked to all USs.

Task T034 ('Implement timeout aggregation script') is tagged [US3] but fulfills SC-005 (Success Criteria) which is explicitly linked to US-4 (System Robustness). While US3 generates the report, the data source (timeout counts) and the requirement (SC-005) belong to US-4. Tagging it only to US3 creates a coverage gap for US-4's specific success criteria in the task list.
